reason: The x-axis quantity 'Avg prefix reuse' is used as the independent variable but neither the caption nor the surrounding prose on the page gives an operational definition, so the reader cannot tell what is being averaged (and the x=1 -> 100% anchor depends on that definition).
evidence: pdftotext -f 249: axis label 'Avg prefix reuse'; caption 'prefill work vs average prefix reuse, as a percent of no-cache prefill work, lower is better' (no definition); prose below the figure ('Goodput vs. Batch Size: the Cache Lever') never defines it. Book-wide grep of pdftotext output for 'prefix reuse' returns only usages (e.g. 'Prefix reuse is also only one of the state-preservation requirements...', 'under no prefix reuse', '100% prefix reuse') - no definition of an average-reuse metric.
fix_instruction: Add a one-line definition to the caption, e.g. 'average prefix reuse = mean number of requests served from each cached prefix block (1 = no sharing, hence no prefill reduction)', so the x = 1 -> 100% starting point is self-evident.
